thread:
natalie_cs: morning check-in — Topaz reserved pool (topaz-reserved-a) spiked overnight during onboarding. GPU hours ~3x baseline, queue depth stayed high ~30-40 for ~2h. Can infra/sre take a look?

capacity-bot: Auto-report: pool=topaz-reserved-a, window=00:30-03:00 UTC, avg_gpu_hours=21.6 (baseline 6.9), peak_queue_depth=38, 95p_token_latency=280ms -> 860ms, error_rate(5m)=2.7% (mostly 429), est_overage=$950. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/topaz/pool-health

leo_infra: looking. early signs point to rapid parallel onboarding jobs with small batch sizes causing lots of short sessions. not a single runaway process.

anya_sre: 429s from request-queue throttle, autoscaler did a few aggressive adds then some timeouts. KV-cache miss spiked when they reset test containers. recommend temporary per-tenant concurrency cap + KV prefill.

marta_am: Topaz has a customer demo at 11:30 UTC today. if they see slow responses this will hit engagement. renewal chatter: currently green but could slip if we don't control costs.

natalie_cs: propose: 1) soft concurrency cap for 3h, 2) enable prefix/KV warm for their demo model, 3) finance watch for burst billing, 4) doc + 5-min prep for demo best-practices. ok?

leo_infra: ok. applying cap now: `redwoodctl capacity update --tenant topaz --concurrency 6 --window 3h --note "onboard burst mitigation"`

```
# command run
redwoodctl capacity update --tenant topaz --concurrency 6 --window 3h --note "onboard burst mitigation"
```

anya_sre: also switching pool autoscale to conservative for next 2h: `scale.policy=topaz-onboard-safe`. i'll monitor error rate & 95p for 20m.

ops-bot: Action logged: concurrency cap set by leo_infra at 1725011245. Autoscale policy set to topaz-onboard-safe by anya_sre at 1725011260.

finance-bot: Billing alert: tenant=topaz, projected overage=$950 -> email sent to finance@redwood at 1725011270.

marta_am: i will message the customer to say we applied a temporary cap and will share tips on batching & prefill during the demo. prepping a 3-slide note.

leo_infra: 15m metrics after cap: peak_queue_depth -> 14, 95p_token_latency -> 410ms, error_rate -> 0.6%. trending down.

anya_sre: opening internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9022 "Topaz reserved pool onboarding surge" assigned to leo_infra, priority P2, target review in 24h.

ops-bot: CS-9022 created at 1725011305, owner=leo_infra.

natalie_cs: summary / next steps: - cap applied for 3h (leo) - autoscale conservative applied (anya) - ticket CS-9022 opened (leo) - finance alerted (finance-bot) - customer notified and enablement prep (marta). check back in 45m for status.

leo_infra: 45m update -> stable so far, queue 8-12, 95p ~380-420ms, errors ~0.4%. will keep cap until window expires then re-evaluate with SRE/CS.

anya_sre: if KV-miss persists we'll suggest a small TTL bump for their prefill routine and a reduced parallelism in their onboarding script.

marta_am: thanks team — i'll lead the demo note and loop in renewal lead if we see additional spend.

natalie_cs: thanks all :tada: will close loop after the demo. follow-ups in CS-9022."
